verdict.rationale: Trivy ships an official first-party MCP server plugin (trivy-mcp) exposing natural-language security scanning to AI agents, and a probe confirmed a working JSON-RPC MCP handshake; additionally the CLI itself is fully scriptable with JSON output and exit codes for automation. No conventional REST/OpenAPI API exists (openapi/llms.txt probes 404), but the documented MCP interface directly satisfies AI-native programmatic access.
